text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to find the risks that could affect your project, such as delays, budget cuts, or technical issues. Once you know them, you can create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, you might train staff or use better equipment. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup solutions if things go wrong. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and protect your goals.
